title: drift-scout-fieldreport-and-hotfix-handoff-2026-07-03
content:
DRIFT SCOUT: biweekly field report + hotfix handoff (compact)
Date: 2026-07-03
Author: Maya Chen (applied-ml)
Context/rationale:
- Quick, operational snapshot for recent onboarding evals and promptset regressions. Meant for engineers, applied ML owners, and oncall to triage and assign immediate fixes.
- This doc deliberately small/operational — not a full postmortem.
Scope:
- Window: 2026-06-20 -> 2026-07-02 (14 days)
- Models: rdlw-13b-v2, open-llama-30b-quant, rdlw-chat-7b-adv (serving-hosted + dedicated test pool)
- Input: onboarding promptsets (customer+internal), synthetic stress suites, production sampled prompts (sanitized)
Summary (top-level):
- Quality delta: median promptset pass rate fell from 93% -> 86% (7pp drop).
- Largest spike in failures occurred on 2026-06-26 after a model rollout (rdlw-13b-v2 config change: reduced kv-cache-retention param).
- Immediate risk: 4 customer promptsets show high-severity semantic failures (hallucination / incorrect entity linking) causing downstream metric regressions (NPS-simulated drop).
Top failure clusters (by signal weight):
1) Entity hallucination on multi-step reasoning prompts (weight 0.28)
   - Examples: prompt id onboard-AC-743: model invents vendor names when constrained by 3-field schema.
   - Observed only on rdlw-13b-v2 after kv-cache retention reduction; older snap had lower rate.
2) Repetition / loop in long-turn chat (weight 0.21)
   - Occurs on rdlw-chat-7b-adv with token-batching >1.5x baseline.
3) Numeric truncation on bulleted lists (weight 0.15)
   - Embedding/formatting mismatch causing trailing characters to be dropped for certain prompt markers.
4) Safety filter false positives (weight 0.12)
   - Hostile content classifier pings when benign technical examples include flagged tokens.
5) Latency fallback leading to lower-quality model (weight 0.09)
   - Smart routing fell back to a quantized open model during a short capacity event.
Root-cause hypotheses (quick):
- Hypothesis A: Recent runtime change (kv-cache retention param) reduced context where prefix conditioning was expected -> hallucination regressions. Evidence: failure spike coincident with rollout, repro by replaying traces with older runtime param.
- Hypothesis B: Autoscaling batching policy increased batch size for chat workloads during peak, exposing decoding instability for small-beam settings.
- Hypothesis C: Tokenization/format normalization change in preprocessor removed sentinel characters in 1% of prompts (explains numeric truncation).
Immediate actions (hotfix candidates, ordered):
- Hotfix 1 (P0): Roll back kv-cache-retention param to previous value for rdlw-13b-v2 in dedicated test pool + monitor promptset pass-rate (Owner: Priya Nair, ETA: 2 hours) -> JIRA-ML-1427 (hotfix/kv-rollback).
- Hotfix 2 (P1): Add aggressive prefix-preserve flag in serving runtime for onboarding routes until further investigation (Owner: Diego Alvarez, ETA: 6 hours).
- Hotfix 3 (P1): Rate-limit batch size for chat endpoints to baseline max_batch=64 for 12 hours (Owner: Samir Patel, ETA: 4 hours).
- Hotfix 4 (P2): Revert preprocessor tokenizer tweak for onboarding pipeline (Owner: Maya Chen, ETA: 1 day).
Short term experiments (48–72h):
- A/B test prompt-preserve wrapper with local caching of prefixes (can reduce hallucination; rollback if latency > +20ms).
- Run synthetic stress harness with kv-cache-retention backfilled to trace proportions (replay 10k sampled sessions).
- Run classifier threshold tuning for safety filter using curated false-positive set (customer-provided).
Action item tracker (owner / status / artifact):
- Priya: execute kv rollback -> assigned -> JIRA-ML-1427
- Diego: deploy prefix-preserve flag to canary -> in_progress -> PR #292
- Samir: enforce batch cap on chat routes -> assigned -> infra-ticket INF-904
- Maya: prepare tokenizer revert patch and unit tests -> draft -> PR link in linked_artifacts
Monitoring and success criteria:
- Primary metric: promptset pass rate back to >= 92% for onboarding sets within 24h of hotfix 1.
- Secondary: no >10ms median latency increase on affected routes after changes.
- Alerting changes: add a temporary synthetic job to run 1k onboard prompts every 15m with pass/fail and diff-level.
Notes from manual triage session (06/30):
- Replays reproduce entity hallucination only when prefix tokens are dropped in the first 64-token window.
- Repro for repetition happens when batch size >= 80 and average sequence length > 256.
- A few failing prompt examples have escaped test coverage because they combine nested JSON+markdown; create a small promptset for that class.
Open questions / escalations:
- Do we need to freeze on any customer-facing model rollouts until stability is demonstrated? (ops decision)
- Can customer-success proactively notify the 4 affected customers with a note and ETA? (owner: CS)
- Should we run a quick review of recent infra changes the week prior? (SRE sync)
Meeting cadence for next 72h:
- Daily 30m triage @ 10:00 AM PT (owners above) — calendar invite: #ml-drift-triage
- Post-hotfix verification call 24h after hotfix completion.
Appendix (quick links + snippets):
- Repro snippet (sanitized):
  >>> System: You are an ordering assistant.
  >>> Prompt: {"customer_request": "Find vendor info for 'Acme Corp' and return 3 fields"} -> model returns invented vendors when prefix omitted.
- Slack threads: #applied-ml (link: slack://channel/applied-ml/TSK12345)
- Related tickets: JIRA-ML-1401 (onboarding coverage gap), INF-904 (batch cap), JIRA-ML-1427 (hotfix rollback)
- Suggested follow-ups for next biweekly report:
  * Consolidate promptset gaps into a prioritized deck (owner: Maya)
  * Run a deeper root-cause for tokenizer change (owner: Diego)
  * Consider adding gating: small e2e smoke test before model rollout to dedicated pools.
Free-form notes / raw observations (scratchpad):
- "saw a weird cluster where model appended 'Ltd.' to company names that never appeared in context"
- "maybe the quantization variant is more brittle on list outputs — add to hypothesis list"
- TODO: annotate failing examples with token offsets and send to infra for kernel-level tracing.
-- end of fieldreport --
